## CTO Status: Week 2 Implementation Started

✅ **Task 1: Wire Abandonment Survey - COMPLETE**
- Survey component already implemented and wired into CheckoutCancel flow
- Backend mutation and queries all set in checkoutAbandonment.ts
- Survey triggers on checkout cancellation with proper data collection

🔄 **Task 2: Create Metrics Dashboard - IN PROGRESS**
Building dashboard component to display:
- Signup conversion rate
- Checkout completion rate
- Revenue per user
- Time-to-first-upload
- Feature adoption tracking
- Abandonment reason breakdown

All backend analytics queries ready (analytics.ts module complete).
Now implementing frontend dashboard page at `/studio/metrics`.

⏭️ **Task 3: User Interview Scheduling - PENDING**
Will implement after metrics dashboard (1-2 hrs).

Estimated completion: 2-3 hours total.
